title: Clips snap to markers, and a marker drags to a new moment
goal: Markers are where an editor notes a moment to come back to, and in Premiere and Final Cut a clip dragged near one catches on it. In Photonz a clip's edge catches on the playhead and on other clips, but slides straight past a marker, and a marker put down in the wrong place can only be removed and added again because it cannot be dragged. Make markers something you can cut and arrange to.
notes: Manager pass 2026-10-05, objective gap against video-cutting success line 'Drag a clip along a track and onto another track, with snapping to clips, the playhead and markers'. Evidence: PhotonzCore/ClipBarDrag.swift:310-327 clipBarEdges lists the document ends, the playhead and clip edges/joins, no markers. TimelineDock.swift:881-888 marker flags ignore clicks; only Extract's ripple moves a marker (MarkedStretch.swift:123). Only the ruler range snaps to markers (RulerRange.swift:118-124); the playhead snaps to keys only (EditorState+KeyLanes.swift:375-381). TimelineMarker is id + atMS (TimelineMarks.swift:14-23). Naming a marker is NOT in scope (it would add a new field; left as an open thread in the manager report).
acceptance: With snapping on (S), dragging a clip or trimming its edge catches on a marker within the same reach it catches on the playhead, and the line under the drag names it (for example 'caught on a marker at 0:12')
The playhead dragged along the ruler catches on markers too while snapping is on
A marker on the ruler drags left or right to a new moment, snapping to clips and the playhead, in one undo step; a click on it still moves the playhead there
With snapping off, nothing catches on a marker
Unit tests in PhotonzCore cover markers in the snap edges and moving a marker, written first
A walk at Next defaults adds a marker with M, drags a clip to it and photographs the catch, then drags the marker and checks its new time
Works at Next defaults with no switch turned on, and an audit written under queue/audits/ gives the try steps and a real picture
Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task's log if it does not
